newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end steady on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end steady on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates held steady at higher levels on Tuesday amid a shortage of funds and dealers said they did not expect any major change in the near term.
The overnight rate was steady at 20 percent amid tight liquidity and banks discounted huge amounts with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP), a dealer at KASB & Co said.
He said little activity was seen in longer term funds but offers were made for 45 days at 16.75 percent and three-month funds at 16.50 percent.
